en: A monochrome blue-tinted postcard showing a coastal landscape with high cliffs and the sea in the foreground. On the right side stands a large, ornate palace-like building with a tower and flag, set back from the edge of the cliffs. Smaller buildings are visible on the left along the shoreline. At the top there is printed text in Cyrillic, Latin, and French identifying the scene.
